complaint: The franchise loyalty app crashed completely, and my global membership points were rejected at this specific location.
The overall quality of this location has tanked over the last six months. The menu is uninspired, and prices are unjustified.
The restaurant was freezing cold and the music was deafening. I complained to the shift leader, but nothing was adjusted.
The kitchen took over an hour and a half to get our main courses out, and half the table got their food late.
Our section was pure chaos. Servers were visibly arguing with each other, and no one was managing the dining area.
The waiters clearly lack basic training. Ours didn't know how to open a wine bottle properly and dropped cutlery on the floor.
We were told we couldn't order draft beer because the bar area had completely run out of clean glassware for the evening.
The delivery tracking system failed, and dispatch was incredibly unhelpful when I called to ask where my food was.
We saw a cockroach crawling near the skirting board by the restrooms. Disgusting sanitation standards.
The person greeting guests at the door rolled their eyes at us and gave a massive attitude when we asked about the wait time.
Our server took our order and then completely ignored us for 45 minutes. We never even got water refills.
We were seated at a table that was still covered in dirty plates, sticky syrup, and used napkins from the previous guests.
I ordered a strictly vegetarian pasta, but found pieces of chicken cooked into the sauce.
The person at the register overcharged me for two extra drinks and it took 15 minutes to figure out how to void the items.
My cocktail tasted like pure sugar syrup. There was absolutely no alcohol in it, and it was missing the garnish.
The cappuccino I ordered was lukewarm, the milk was burnt, and it tasted extremely stale.
The restrooms were in a horrible state. Trash cans were overflowing, floors were wet, and there was no toilet paper left.
My delivery order arrived completely cold, and the drinks had tipped over and spilled inside the plastic bag.
The parking lot felt incredibly unsafe, poorly lit, and there was no staff monitoring the premises like there usually is.
